facts.fact: 冰路失控：车滑出路面撞树——玻璃如雨、安全袋接住头部。
facts.anchor: My car has veered off the road, and time seems to stretch into an eternity.

facts.fact: 眉骨上方伤口渗血；路边空无一人，她独自坐在冷车里。
facts.anchor: My trembling hand lifts to feel the warm trickling blood coming from a cut just above my eyebrow.

facts.fact: 骄傲差点拦住她——但他是唯一能在这种路况开车的人，电话拨了出去。
facts.anchor: Sometimes my pride can get the best of me, but he is the only person I know who can drive in this weather.

facts.fact: 电话里她声音沙哑、一直在忍泪：Sean，我需要你来接我。
facts.anchor: I need you to come get me.

facts.fact: 卡车手机架上 recent calls 顶端赫然是「My Bee <3」——备注与心形齐飞。
双方互歉收场：她认 overreacted，他说「错的是我，是个混蛋」。
facts.anchor: You have nothing to be sorry for. I was a jerk.

facts.fact: 他交底：十年想要你、等我们的时刻——所以才想护住「我们」；她把手放上他手背：This is real.
疤痕点名：右脸颊七岁被爱犬咬的疤、每颗雀斑、每根头发——I remember all of you.
facts.anchor: Where my childhood dog bit me when I was seven.

facts.fact: 卧室门口他停手确认；她从未如此确定——I want Sean Kingsley more than I ever have.
facts.anchor: Are you sure you want to do this
